jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Co-Star

Someone downloads CoâStar every 5 seconds.

In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries â missing just North Korea and Eritrea.

We don't pay for marketing â we designed the app to go viral, and it did.

Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.

Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people â in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.

Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.

We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.

Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, CoâStar generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes â a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. jobs.title: Vil du lede Norges fremste juridiske fagmiljø innen kulturmiljøforvaltning?
jobs.description:
Riksantikvaren søker en tydelig og fremtidsrettet seksjonssjef til juridisk seksjon. Rollen gir en unik mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi tar vare på kulturarven, samtidig som du utvikler medarbeidere, setter strategisk retning og bidrar til en effektiv og helhetlig offentlig forvaltning. Seksjonen består av åtte jurister og er én av fem seksjoner i kulturminneavdelingen. Seksjonssjefen rapporter til avdelingsdirektør og er en del av avdelingens ledergruppe.
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Som seksjonssjef for juridisk seksjon har du det faglige, økonomiske og personalmessige ansvaret for seksjonens arbeid. Du følger opp og prioriterer klagesaksbehandling, sikrer høy kvalitet i juridiske vurderinger, og bidrar med juridisk rådgivning internt  og overfor eksterne aktører.
  • Du har ansvar for å koordinere seksjonens leveranser, herunder saksbehandling, innspill til høringer og oppdrag til departementet. Videre skal du legge til rette for god samhandling med øvrige fagmiljøer og med regional kulturmiljøforvaltning. Seksjonen utarbeider retningslinjer, gir veiledning og bidrar til en enhetlig praksis i sektoren, særlig overfor fylkeskommunene og Sametinget.
  • Som leder vil du utvikle et sterkt fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og gjennomføringsevne. Du skal sette retning, prioritere ressurser og videreutvikle seksjonens arbeid i tråd med Riksantikvarens strategier og samfunnsoppdrag.
Kvalifikasjoner

For å lykkes i rollen ser vi etter deg som har solid faglig bakgrunn og relevant ledererfaring

  • Juridisk embetseksamen eller master i rettsvitenskap
  • Relevant erfaring fra offentlig forvaltning, herunder arbeid med kulturminneloven, plan- og bygningsloven og forvaltningsrett
  • Erfaring med klagesaksbehandling og/eller annen offentlig myndighetsutøvelse
  • God forståelse for statlig forvaltning og rammebetingelser
  • Dokumentert ledererfaring, med evne til å utvikle medarbeidere og fagmiljø
  • Erfaring med økonomistyring og bruk av relevante digitale verktøy
  • Kjennskap til forvaltning av tilskuddsordninger er en fordel
  • Meget god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Stillingen krever at du kan sikkerhetsklareres til konfidensielt nivå etter sikkerhetsloven
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter en leder som kombinerer faglig trygghet med evne til å skape retning og godt samarbeid.

  • Du er en tydelig og trygg leder som skaper retning, prioriterer og følger opp resultater
  • Du har høy faglig integritet og evner å gjøre gode, balanserte vurderinger i komplekse saker
  • Du arbeider strukturert og har god gjennomføringsevne
  • Du bygger tillit og samarbeider godt på tvers av fagmiljøer og forvaltningsnivåer
  • Du kommuniserer klart og overbevisende, også i krevende faglige spørsmål
  • Du evner å tenke strategisk og se sammenhenger mellom jus, fag og samfunnsoppdrag
  • Du motiverer og utvikler medarbeidere, og bidrar til et godt faglig og sosialt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende lederstilling med stor påvirkningskraft
  • Mulighet til å bidra til utviklingen av kulturmiljøpolitikken i Norge
  • Arbeid i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Et godt og inspirerende fag- og arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode muligheter for personlig- og faglig utvikling
  • Fleksitid, sommertid og mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden. 1 lønnet treningstime per uke
  • Medlemskap i og pensjonsordning gjennom Statens Pensjonskasse med gode pensjons-, lån- og forsikringsordninger
  • Stillingen lønnes som seksjonssjef i henhold til Statens lønnsregulativ og Riksantikvarens lønnspolitikk fra kr 1.000 000 til 1.150 000. For spesielt kvalifiserte kandidater kan høyere lønn vurderes.

Medarbeiderskap
Hos Riksantikvaren har vi verdier og medarbeiderprinsipper. Dette innebærer at du som medarbeider hos Riksantikvaren er samfunnsengasjert, nytenkende og kompetent. I tillegg tar du ansvar for egne oppgaver, kollegaer og Riksantikvarens overordnede mål. I vår vurdering av kandidater vil vi vektlegge disse verdiene og prinsippene.

Andre opplysninger
Riksantikvaren er en IA-bedrift som jobber for å realisere regjeringens inkluderingsdugnad for personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne og hull i CV-en. Dersom det er kvalifiserte søkere med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn, skal vi innkalle minst én søker i hver av disse gruppene til intervju. For å bli vurdert som søker i disse gruppene, det vil si bli positivt særbehandlet på denne måten, må søkerne oppfylle visse krav. Les mer om kravene i Arbeidsgiverportalen.

Vi oppfordrer deg som oppfyller kravene om positiv særbehandling om å krysse av i jobbportalen dersom du har funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn. Avkrysningene i jobbsøkerportalen danner grunnlag for anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter.

Riksantikvaren holder til i moderne, historiske lokaler sentralt i Oslo med kort vei til offentlig transport. Vi har gode tilretteleggingsmuligheter ved behov. Staten er opptatt av mangfold og vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Når du søker jobb hos oss vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor. Vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Hvis vi ikke kan det, hører du selvsagt fra oss før vi offentliggjør søkerlisten.

jobs.title: Research Assistant within the Section of Pharmacogenetics
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?

We invite applications for a Research Assistant position in the research group of Professor Magnus Ingelman-Sundberg, within the Section of Pharmacogenetics.



This position is housed in the Department of Physiology and Pharmacology, known for its collegial, international, and dynamic research environment. Our current research focuses on the use CYP2C19 is a highly polymorphic enzyme involved in the metabolism of many drugs and endogenous lipids, making it one of the most clinically important pharmacogenes. Beyond drug metabolism, CYP2C19 regulates lipid pathways influencing vascular function, inflammation, cholesterol homeostasis, and broader metabolic processes. We will investigate why fetal CYP2C19 expression induces inflammation in the developing hippocampus, leading to neuronal degeneration in the adult dentate gyrus causing anxiety and depression in adult life identifying molecular pathways relevant for future antidepressant development. Reduced CYP2C19 function has been associated with increased risk of myocardial infarction and ischemic stroke, suggesting broader roles in cardiovascular disease. Using advanced human liver spheroids and brain organoids, we will study CYP2C19 in lipid metabolism ini relation to cardiovascular risk, by identifying CYP2C19-dependent lipid pathways providing new insights into mechanisms underlying neuropsychiatric disorders and arteriosclerosis.



Your profile

We are seeking a motivated candidate with at least one year of hands-on laboratory experience and practical skills in RT-PCR, Western blotting, and cell culture. Experience in immunohistochemistry, imaging techniques, and molecular biology methods is highly desirable. Previous work with brain tissues is a merit.

You will join a dynamic research team of approximately six researchers and contribute to several ongoing projects focused on the biological functions of CYP2C19. Your primary responsibilities will include:

· Analysis of lipids regulated by CYP2C19 using advanced 3D human liver spheroids as an experimental model.

· Characterization of developmental alterations in the fetal brain caused by CYP2C19 overexpression using approaches such as immunohistochemistry, RNA sequencing, and ELISA.

· Development and use of in vitro macrophage activation systems to investigate whether CYP2C19-dependent lipid mediators promote inflammatory pathways relevant to atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.

While knowledge of the Swedish language is advantageous, fluency in both oral and written English is essential.

The successful candidate will be a team player with excellent communication skills, well-organized, and enjoy interacting with researchers and students.



What We Offer

Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to advance knowledge about life and promote better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and offer the largest range of medical education in Sweden. As a state university, we provide numerous benefits through our collective agreement, including access to modern wellness facilities with trained staff on-site.

Your ability to lead, collaborate, and deliver results will be essential in achieving our strategic objectives and exceeding client expectations. The position can be filled on any Kuehne+Nagel location in the EMEA region.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) to lead and oversee complex global customer implementation projects and programs from initiation to successful stabilization within a defined business vertical. As part of the vertical PMO, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. You will collaborate with the related vertical leadership teams on the Sales side and the Business Unit Air Logistics side to develop vertical related strategic goals and best practice to continuously meet the market requirements and conditions of our customers. This role requires at least 5 years of experience in leading/driving large, complex projects and/or programs through complete project Life-cycle, preferably on an international basis and a solid operational background in Air Logistics.

How you create impact
* Project Planning and Initiation: Lead project definition, scope, and objectives by collaborating with stakeholders. Create detailed plans, including timelines, resource and risk management
* Project Execution and Control: Guide teams, ensuring alignment with goals. Monitor progress, address deviations, and maintain proactive issue resolution
* Resource Management: Allocate and secure resources, collaborating with functional managers for expertise and success

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer (CEO) / Managing Director
jobs.description:
Lead the next generation international law firm powered by AI.

Lawgent is looking for a commercially driven and highly operational Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead our day to day business and help build one of Europe's most modern legal and compliance companies.

This is not a traditional CEO position.

We are looking for someone who thrives on execution, builds high performing teams, makes confident decisions and ensures that strategy turns into measurable results. You will work closely with the Chairman and Board while having significant autonomy to scale the business.

About Lawgent

Lawgent helps companies navigate the future of law with expertise in:

    

EU AI Act

    

GDPR

    

DORA

    

Data Governance Act

    

Digital Services Act

    

Employment Law

    

Commercial Law

    

Corporate Law

    

Compliance and Risk Management

Alongside our legal services, we are developing AI powered solutions, international education platforms and digital products for businesses across Europe and beyond.

Your Responsibilities

As CEO, you will:

    

Lead the company's daily operations.

    

Execute the company's strategic objectives.

    

Build, develop and lead a high performing organisation.

    

Recruit, coach and develop key talent.

    

Take full responsibility for financial performance and profitability.

    

Monitor KPIs and continuously improve operational efficiency.

    

Work closely with the Board and Chairman.

    

Drive sales, growth and business development.

    

Ensure outstanding client satisfaction and service quality.

    

Lead digital transformation initiatives, including AI implementation.

    

Build a culture defined by accountability, performance and excellence.

We Believe You Have

    

Previous experience as a CEO, COO, Managing Director or senior executive.

    

A proven track record of scaling businesses.

    

Strong commercial and financial acumen.

    

Experience with budgeting, forecasting and P&L responsibility.

    

Exceptional leadership and people management skills.

    

The ability to make decisions quickly and confidently.

    

A structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.

    

Excellent communication skills in English. Additional European languages are an advantage.

Experience within legal services, consulting, AI, SaaS or international expansion is considered highly desirable.

What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to build an international company with significant growth ambitions.

You will join an entrepreneurial organisation where decisions are made quickly, innovation is encouraged and your impact will be visible from day one.

You will work alongside international experts in law, artificial intelligence and digital transformation while helping shape the future of legal services.

Employment

    

Full time

    

Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

    

Start date: By agreement

Application

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter explaining why you are the right person to lead Lawgent into its next stage of growth.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About Lawgent

At Lawgent, we believe the future of legal services belongs to organisations that combine legal expertise, artificial intelligence and business innovation. If you are ready to build, lead and scale an international legal company, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Social Community Representative
jobs.description:
The Social Community Representative is responsible for engaging with consumers, creators, and ambassadors across social media channels to build community, strengthen brand affinity, and support a positive customer experience. This remote, part-time role combines community management, creator support, social engagement, and content execution to help drive meaningful connections and brand growth.

Reporting to the DIGITAL COMMUNITIES' ASSOCIATE MANAGER, the SOCIAL COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVE will support our collegiate team in the following areas and meet the job requirements below.

This is a remote, part-time position.

--

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to direct messages, comments, tagged content, and community interactions across social media platforms to support audience engagement and strengthen brand affinity.
  • Act as a trusted voice of the brand by reviewing and responding to consumer, creator, and ambassador inquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Identify and report recurring community themes, ambassador questions, consumer complaints, and engagement opportunities to help improve brand communications and customer experience.

Requirements

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Role: Recruiter & People Operations Specialist

Base Salary: $95,000 - $110,000

We're looking for a People Operations Specialist to lead recruiting across Blackthorn while also supporting core people operations work. You'll own the full-cycle hiring process for open roles company-wide â from intake through offer â while partnering with the VP of People Operations on onboarding, HR systems, and day-to-day operational support. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role suited to someone who enjoys both the relationship-driven work of recruiting and the precision of operational execution.

What youâll do

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for roles across the company, from intake calls with hiring managers through offer negotiation.
  • Source, screen, and manage candidate pipelines using our ATS, partnering closely with hiring managers on role requirements and timelines.
  • Build and maintain a strong candidate experience at every stage of the process.
  • Track recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and report regularly to leadership.

People Operations Support



  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a smooth experience for new hires and departing employees.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data.
  • Assist with benefits administration and respond to employee questions on policies and programs.
  • Help maintain compliance with employment law across the states (and potentially countries) where Blackthorn has employees.

Process & Systems Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline recruiting and HR operational workflows.
  • Partner with the VP of People Operations on building scalable people processes as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 3â5+ years of experience in recruiting, with some HR or people operations exposure.
  • Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruiting independently, including sourcing, screening, and closing candidates.
  • Comfortable working with HRIS and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can build trust with hiring managers and candidates alike.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a remote-first, distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for a B2B SaaS or Salesforce ecosystem company.
  • Familiarity with PEOs or multi-state employment compliance.

What we offer

  • An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  • A deep feeling of satisfaction and completion
  • Fully remote global team working from home
  • Stock options for every employee
  • Flexible work week
  • $400 office stipend
  • Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Student loan debt assistance
  • Pledge 1% - time off during the year for helping nonprofits
  • Health insurance contribution (if in the US)
  • Children's 529 college fund assistance (if in the US)

About Blackthorn

Blackthorn turns any organization's SalesforceÂ® CRM into event planning software powered by their connected data. We're a growing, distributed team with teammates across the globe, and we build Salesforce-native tools that help teams create events, engage attendees, process payments, and measure success â all without leaving their CRM. Our customers range from tiny nonprofits to global corporations, and our products are known for going live in hours, not weeks. We believe the best enterprise software should feel as intuitive as the apps you use every day.

Why our work matters

Most event management tools force teams to juggle disconnected systems, wrestle with flimsy integrations, and spend more time syncing data than planning events. We're building the alternative: a connected platform inside Salesforce that gives organizations richer analytics to prove event ROI, better attendee experiences through personalization and automation, and the flexibility to fit any workflow. Every feature we ship helps our customers spend less time on logistics and more time on the events themselves.

What the job will bring you

A deep level of satisfaction through ownership of your role. You'll get more autonomy than at other companies (our team has told us). Connection. Our team is tightly knit, assisted through occasional team meetups (as we're remote). Challenge. We're trying to move as quickly as possible. This is not for you if you want to sit back and chill. As Ray Dalio says about life, "Meaningful work and meaningful relationships" provide meaning to life. We aim to bring this.

While we are a remote-first culture, we are currently only able to accept applicants in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, and WI

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Key responsibilities
Firmware and embedded software development: - Develop and maintain embedded software and firmware primarily in Rust. - Use C where relevant for embedded and low-level development. - Develop for bare-metal RISC-V and embedded Linux on ARM environments. - Implement reliable software for resource-constrained embedded systems. - Investigate and resolve software, firmware and system-level issues. Hardware integration and verification: - Integrate firmware with electronics, hardware and communication interfaces. - Test, debug and validate software on target hardware. - Support hardware–software integration and system-level testing. - Contribute to verification activities and resolve integration issues. Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

Option to work from home: No

Our customers are some of the most iconic brands and logistics companies in the world, and we have already transformed the way they work.


We are an international team (Nashville, Chicago, Europe) with a growing presence at our Nashville HQ.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Native Storage Engineer Ceph (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die noris network AG steht für innovative, sichere und nachhaltige IT-Lösungen. Mit über 600 engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir leistungsstarke Services in den Bereichen Cloud, Datacenter, Network & Security sowie Managed Applications – betrieben auf einer hochmodernen, mehrfach zertifizierten IT-Infrastruktur mit eigenen Hochsicherheitsrechenzentren. Seit 1993 sind wir kontinuierlich gewachsen und zählen heute zu den führenden IT-Spezialisten in Deutschland. Unser größtes Kapital? Ein starkes, diverses Team mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mitzugestalten. Deshalb fördern wir Eigenverantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und frische Ideen – in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit vereint.

Du willst Storage nicht nur betreiben, sondern wirklich gestalten?

Für Dich ist Storage mehr als Kapazität und Festplatten? Du willst verstehen, was im Cluster passiert, wenn OSDs ausfallen, Daten neu verteilt werden, Latenzen steigen oder mehrere Petabytes zuverlässig wachsen müssen?

Dann werde Teil unseres Cloud Native Teams und gestalte die Storage-Basis unserer souveränen Cloud-Plattform. Wir setzen auf Open Source, eigene deutsche Rechenzentren und Technologien wie Ceph, OpenStack und Kubernetes. Dabei verbinden wir technische Freiheit mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Auditierbarkeit.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere produktiven Ceph-Cluster und entwickelst deren Architektur kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du betreibst, administrierst und optimierst Ceph RBD sowie den Ceph Object Storage mit RGW und einer S3-kompatiblen Schnittstelle
  • Du planst und realisierst Upgrades, Erweiterungen sowie Lifecycle-Maßnahmen und setzt diese strukturiert und weitestgehend automatisiert um
  • Du analysierst Performance-, Kapazitäts- und Stabilitätsprobleme und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen zu deren Behebung
  • Du entwickelst unsere Automatisierung mit Ansible, Python und Git kontinuierlich weiter und reduzierst manuelle Eingriffe durch reproduzierbare Prozesse
  • Du integrierst Ceph in unsere Cloud-Plattformen, insbesondere in OpenStack- und Kubernetes-Umgebungen
  • Du optimierst Monitoring, Alerting, Capacity Management sowie unsere technischen Betriebsstandards kontinuierlich
  • Du bearbeitest komplexe Incidents und Problems im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support, führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und leitest nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab
  • Du dokumentierst Architekturentscheidungen, Betriebsverfahren und Automatisierungen nachvollziehbar und revisionssicher
  • Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen als technische Ansprechperson, teilst dein Wissen aktiv im Team und förderst den fachlichen Austausch

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Engineering und Betrieb komplexer Linux- und Storage-Infrastrukturen
  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Ceph in produktiven Umgebungen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Linux sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis verteilte Systeme und deren Architektur
  • Erfahrung mit Fehleranalyse, Performance-Tuning, Kapazitätsplanung sowie Upgrade- und Lifecycle-Prozessen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung mit Ansible und idealerweise Python
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git und nachvollziehbaren, versionskontrollierten Arbeitsweisen
  • Solides Verständnius von Netzwerktechnologien wie Routing, DNS, Firewalling und NAT
  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Freude daran, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu vertreten
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, ein technisches Studium oder eine durch einschlägige Berufserfahrung erworbene gleichwertige Qualifikation

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Ruhezeitenausgleich auf Dein Stundenkonto
  • Arbeiten an verschiedenen Standorten möglich (z.B. Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin) oder auch zu 100% Remote
  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Laptop und Firmenhandy auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Förderung und Weiterentwicklung durch Inhouse-Trainings und externe Schulungen
  • Kinderbetreuungskostenzuschuss (pro Monat/Kind) und Corporate Benefits
  • Attraktive Firmenevents (inkl. Reisekostenübernahme), kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie Duz-Kultur ab dem ersten Tag

jobs.title: Senior Consultant Azure Data Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Senior Consultant Azure Data Engineer unterstützt du ein strategisches Daten- und Reporting-Transformationsvorhabens mit Zielplattform Microsoft-Fabric. Der Fokus liegt auf der technischen Konzeption und Implementierung von Microsoft Fabric, beginnend mit PoC- und Pilot-Szenarien für ein gemeinsames Reporting aus SAS 9.4 und SAP BW mittels Power BI. Ziel ist es, die interne IT zu befähigen, die Plattform mittel- bis langfristig eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln und zu betreiben sowie eine fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Ablösung bestehender DWH-Plattformen zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Zu Deinen Kernaufgaben zählen folgende Bereiche:

  • Analyse der bestehenden Daten- und Reporting-Landschaften
  • Erarbeitung technischen Zielarchitekturen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Power BI Semantic Models)
  • Definition geeigneter Integrations- und Migrationsszenarien (Koexistenz, schrittweise Ablösung, Parallelbetrieb)
  • Technische Konzeption der Datenanbindung von SAS und SAP BW an Microsoft Fabric
  • Konzeption performanter Datenmodelle und semantischer Schichten für Power BI sowie das Erstellen von Row-Level-Security-Konzepten
  • Definition von Governance-, Security- und Berechtigungskonzepten in Fabric und Power BI
  • Bewertung von Ablöse-Optionen für SAS 9.4 und SAP BW inkl. Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Migrationsaufwand
  • Begleitende technische Umsetzung der PoC- und Pilot-Projekte auf Microsoft Fabric
  • Aufbau und Konfiguration von Fabric Artefakten (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2)
  • Implementierung der Datenbelieferung aus SAS 9.4 und SAP BW nach OneLake
  • Technische Umsetzung von Transformations- und Ladeprozessen
  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Power-BI-Semantic-Models für das gemeinsame Reporting
  • Sicherstellung von Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit
  • Umsetzung technischer Best Practices für Fabric und Power BI
  • Technische Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Begleitung der Umsetzungsarbeiten der internen Teams

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen sollst:

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von PoC- und Pilotprojekten im Analytics-Umfeld
  • Fundierte Microsoft Azure Technologie-Kenntnisse
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI (Semantic Models, DAX, Performance-Optimierung)
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von Legacy-DWH-Systemen (insbesondere SAS 9.x und SAP BW)
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung, ETL/ELT-Prozessen und Performance-Optimierung
  • Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse, idealerweise ergänzt durch Spark-/Data-Engineering-Erfahrung
  • Erfahrung im Versicherungs-, Banken- oder regulierten Umfeld wünschenswert
  • Kenntnisse in Data Governance, Security und DSGVO-konformer Datenverarbeitung
  • Fähigkeit zur Bewertung von Migrations- und Ablöseszenarien für bestehende Plattformen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Fokuszeit: Weiterbildungsbudget von bis zu 12 Tagen pro Jahr für fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung (z. B. Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, neue Technologien) — als Teil der Arbeitszeit, nicht der Freizeit.

Mobilität: Jobrad und Deutschlandticket für projektbezogene Reisen.

Workation: zeitweise auch aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten, in Abstimmung mit Projekt und Team.

CYOD (Choose Your Own Device): eigenes Setup aus einem modernen Hardware-Portfolio — MacBook oder High-End-Laptop, iPhone oder Android.

Berufsbegleitendes Studium: als Partner des DHBW Center for Advanced Studies ein berufsbegleitendes Masterstudium in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik.

Wir arbeiten in flachen Hierarchien und einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld und fördern den Teamgeist. Wir leben den Austausch und den respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Wichtig ist uns ein strukturierter Einstieg mit Mentoring und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dadurch stehen allen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung offen. Unser umfangreiches Weiterbildungsangebot sorgt dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Ein ständiger Wissensaustausch ist uns dabei sehr wichtig. Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten. Eine attraktive Vergütung und ein eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget runden die Arbeit bei uns ab.

jobs.title: 3 Dekkmontører søkes til høstsesongen – Mulighet for fast stilling!
jobs.description:
Dekk AS på Rud søker 3 engasjerte dekkmontører til høstsesongen 2026! Vi har høyt tempo og godt humør, og for den rette personen vil det være mulighet for 100 % fast ansettelse etter endt sesong.

Hva vi ser etter

Hvem er du?

  • Du har førerkort klasse B for manuelt gir (dette er et absolutt krav, da du skal flytte alle typer kundebiler inn og ut av verkstedet).

  • Du liker fysisk arbeid, tar i et tak, og er i god fysisk form.

  • Du er nøyaktig, strukturert og har god ordenssans selv når tempoet er høyt.

  • Du er en lagspiller som trives i et aktivt miljø.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Om stillingen: Vi søker praktisk anlagte personer som vil være med å sørge for effektiv drift av vårt dekkverksted og dekkhotell i den travleste perioden av året.

Dine hovedoppgaver:

  • Dekkomlegging og montering av dekk.

  • Kjøring av kunders biler inn og ut av verkstedhallen.

  • Bidra til å holde orden og yte god kundeservice.

  • Stillingen gjelder sesongarbeid på heltid fra starten av september 2026 til slutten av november 2026.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Mulighet for 100 % fast ansettelse for én av kandidatene etter endt sesong.

  • En hektisk, spennende og fartsfylt arbeidsplass.

  • Et trivelig og sammensveiset arbeidsmiljø med gode kollegaer.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser.

  • God og relevant arbeidserfaring.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dekk AS er et veletablert og offentlig godkjent dekkverksted. Vi tilbyr salg og montering av alt fra trillebårdekk til varebildekk, og driver et populært dekkhotell. Med en moderne maskinpark utfører vi alt av tjenester relatert til dekk -- herunder hjulskift, omlegging og dekkreparasjoner (samt skifte av vindusviskere). Vi er stolte av vår høye servicegrad og profesjonelle utførelse.

Kom gjerne innom oss på Rud for en uformell prat hvis du vil se hvordan vi har det!

Risk & Quality Management

Change Management & Adoption

  • Lead organizational change initiatives supporting the ERP transformation.

  • Experience with organizational change management and user adoption strategies.
  • Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on program execution.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio. We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy. If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product andthe product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.
  • You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.
  • You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.
  • You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements byresearching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.
  • You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING:

  • You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.
  • You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.
  • You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.
  • You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.
  • You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.
  • You are fluent in written and spoken English.

ALSO DESIRABLE:

  • Your experience with products in computer vision, AI, or video management domains is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.
  • Innovation where it matters - A challenging position in a company that is changing the world of video data: With you we will make history.
  • Creative and entrepreneurial playground - Get a chance to be your own master, define your own tasks, actively contribute and implement your ideas. Grow yourself and grow the success of the company with direct influence from day one.
  • Team spirit celebrates diversity - Numerous events to get to know the teams and meet our great visionaries.
  • Flexible working hours - Trust-based and goal-oriented working culture.
  • Benefits to smooth your ride in life - Public transport ticket with a 50% subsidy and a huge discount on Urban Sports Club memberships.
  • Boost your learning – we’ll fund it - We offer a generous learning budget so you can improve your skills.
  • Loft-office in central Berlin - With free drinks and a large balcony with barbecue.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

We are a diverse, ambitious team with a great passion for data privacy, generative AI and startups. Our office is in the heart of Berlin, one of the coolest, most vibrant cities worldwide. We enjoy teamwork and celebrating successes together. If you are looking for a new challenge with real impact from day one, check out our job openings and apply today!

jobs.title: Sykepleier i rehabiliteringsavdelingen, Bydel Grünerløkka
jobs.description:
Bydel Grünerløkka har en veldrevet og fleksibel hjemmetjeneste. Rehabiliteringsavdelingen ligger innunder Helse og mestring og i seksjonen Rehabilitering og hjemmesykepleie. Vi er en fremtidsrettet virksomhet som legger vekt på å støtte brukerne til å leve et mest mulig selvstendig liv, gjennom å gi nødvendig helsehjelp og annen bistand, der de bor.

Rehabiliteringsavdelingen søker nå en sykepleiere til 100% fast stilling i to-delt turnus. Stillingen er p.d.d primært en dagstilling med arbeidshelg hver fjerde helg. Avdelingen har et relativt ungt miljø hvor det er stor takhøyde for utvikling, tett samarbeid, fleksibilitet og muligheter til kompetanseheving.

Målgruppen for rehabiliteringsavdelingen er mennesker i avklaringsfase og med behov for rehabilitering i hjemmet. Vi jobber målrettet med både fagspesifikk rehabilitering og med hverdagsrehabilitering. Du vil jobbe tett med ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeut og hjelpepleier for å best mulig nå brukers mål. Tverrfaglig samarbeid blir et viktig fokus i din arbeidshverdag.
Forebyggende arbeid er også en stor del av avdelingens oppgaver. Her ønsker vi også å ha et stort fokus på tverrfaglighet! Det betyr at du som sykepleier har store muligheter for å gjøre oppgaver på tvers av avdelinger og brukergrupper. For eksempel å veilede ulike pasientgrupper i samarbeid med ergoterapeut og fysioterapeut. Vi legger vekt på at du har jobbet innenfor rehabiliteringsfeltet tidligere.


Tilstedelse 1/9-2026


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Tverrfaglig kartlegginger
  • Utføre faglig observasjon og dokumentasjon
  • Tilrettelegge for egenmestring og brukermedvirkning
  • Utføre pleie og omsorgsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for å utøve tjenesten etter gjeldene lovverk og retningslinjer
  • Bidra innen internundervisning og brukerveiledning
  • Samarbeide tett med andre tjenester
  • Ha kompetanse og være kontinuerlig oppdatert om det som skjer innen fagområdet
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisert sykepleier
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra rehabilitering
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig arbeid
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra hjemmebaserte tjenester
  • Ønskelig med erfaring med kartleggingsverktøy brukt i rehabilitering og med MI
  • Ønskelig med erfaring med bruk av Gerica
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du må ha et engasjement for rehabilitering
  • Du må være løsningsfokusert, fleksibel og ha evne til å jobbe selvstendig og strukturert
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og kunne bidra i et tverrfaglig team
  • Liker utfordringer og tar initiativ  
  • God evne til å motivere andre
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges
Vi tilbyr
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode og inkluderende kollegaer
  • En variert og fleksibel arbeidshverdag, med primært dagarbeid med turnus hver fjerde helg.
  • Kompetanseheving
  • Lønnsplassering lønnstrinn 30-43 avhengig av ansiennitet

ArbeidsstedMalmøgata 1
0566 OSLO
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune

Referansenr.: 5157905307
Stillingsprosent: 100%

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Grünerløkka er en sentrumsbydel med et rikt kulturliv og sosialt mangfold. 

Bydelen er den største blant Oslos bydeler etter befolkningstall, med 64.000 innbyggere. Vi har store og solide fagmiljøer og tilbyr ulike tjenester rundt de viktigste rammene av innbyggernes liv. Bydel Grünerløkka legger vekt på brukermedvirkning og samhandling med innbyggere og andre offentlige og private aktører.

Vi ønsker ansatte som er ambisiøse på egne og samfunnets vegne. Våre ledere er opptatt av å legge til rette for gode utviklingsmuligheter.

Som ansatt i Bydel Grünerløkka vil du oppleve en inkluderende kultur med stor takhøyde og mye engasjement for hverandre og de vi jobber for.

Våre ledere og ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

jobs.title: Klinisch psycholoog of psychotherapeut , eetstoornissen
jobs.description:
Voor onze multidisciplinaire groepspraktijk zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste en betrokken klinisch psycholoog met expertise en/of een sterke affiniteit met eetstoornissen om ons team in onze vestiging te Bouwel te versterken.

Onze praktijklocatie in Bouwel biedt een inspirerende werkomgeving. Naast een comfortabele gespreksruimte binnen, zijn er ook mogelijkheden om cliënten te begeleiden in de omliggende natuur. De groene, rustige omgeving leent zich uitstekend voor wandelgesprekken en therapeutische trajecten in openlucht. Daarnaast wordt op deze locatie gewerkt met paarden binnen zowel individuele begeleidingstrajecten als groepswerkingen.

Binnen onze praktijk staat cliëntgerichte zorg op maat centraal. We begeleiden cliënten vanaf de intakefase en werken zowel zelfstandig als in nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit verschillende disciplines. Voor deze functie zoeken we specifiek een psycholoog die zich wil engageren in en ervaring heeft met de begeleiding van cliënten met eetstoornissen en eetgerelateerde problematieken.

We vinden het belangrijk dat iedere hulpverlener vanuit zijn of haar eigen expertise, interesses en therapeutische stijl kan werken. Daarom krijg je de ruimte om naast eetstoornissen ook andere doelgroepen of hulpvragen op te nemen die aansluiten bij jouw professionele profiel.

Binnen onze praktijk maak je deel uit van een team waarin reeds andere collega's werkzaam zijn met expertise en ervaring in de begeleiding van eetstoornissen. Dit biedt mogelijkheden tot overleg, intervisie en multidisciplinaire samenwerking rond deze doelgroep. Tegelijk kan je rekenen op de ondersteuning en inzichten van het bredere team van zorgverleners, waardoor kennis en expertise vanuit verschillende disciplines samenkomen.

Naast individuele begeleiding bieden we binnen de praktijk ook mogelijkheden voor groepswerking. Heb je interesse in het ontwikkelen en begeleiden van groepstrajecten, workshops, psycho-educatieve sessies of thematische programma's rond eetstoornissen, zelfbeeld, emotieregulatie of aanverwante thema's? Dan krijg je de nodige ondersteuning om deze initiatieven verder vorm te geven. Het uitbouwen van groepstrajecten is echter geen must.

Samenwerking, overleg en kennisdeling vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van onze werking. We organiseren regelmatig teamoverleg, intervisies en multidisciplinaire afstemmingsmomenten, waarbij collega's elkaar ondersteunen, inspireren en expertise uitwisselen. Op die manier bouwen we samen aan kwalitatieve, afgestemde en duurzame zorg.

Als klinisch psycholoog maak je deel uit van een warm en multidisciplinair team van zorgverleners. Door onze krachten te bundelen streven we naar een geïntegreerde aanpak die aansluit bij de noden van elke cliënt.

Voel jij je aangesproken door de begeleiding van cliënten met eetstoornissen, werk je graag samen binnen een multidisciplinair team en spreekt een praktijkomgeving met ruimte voor natuur- en ervaringsgerichte begeleiding je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.

Doorheen de jaren is binnen onze praktijk een stabiele instroom van aanmeldingen opgebouwd, met onder meer een duidelijke vraag naar begeleiding bij eetstoornissen en aanverwante problematieken. Toch vinden we het belangrijk dat je initiatief neemt in het uitbouwen en onderhouden van jouw professionele netwerk. Daarnaast staan professionele groei, leergierigheid en permanente vorming centraal in onze werking. We moedigen teamleden aan om hun kennis verder te ontwikkelen.

Een bijkomende (lopende of afgeronde) opleiding in de psychotherapie vormt hierbij een waardevolle meerwaarde, maar is geen vereiste.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Manager:in
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

  • Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
  • Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
  • Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
  • Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
  • Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
  • Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
  • Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
  • Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
  • Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
  • Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
  • Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
  • Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

Klingt das nach einer Stelle, in der du etwas bewegen kannst und möchtest? Dann meld’ dich bei uns! Wir freuen uns schon auf ein Gespräch mit dir!

jobs.title: Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Head of Treasury to join our global Energy Storage Business organisation in a rapidly growing renewable energy market.


This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead the treasury function of a newly carved-out business, taking full ownership of building treasury operations from the ground up. As the ideal candidate you will have direct experience of this process.

You will set up banking structures, develop treasury processes, manage liquidity routines and ensure a seamless transition into an independently operating group of companies. Success in this role requires solid expertise in cash and liquidity management, financial risk management, hedging and bank relationship management.

You should also be comfortable navigating compliance, internal controls and treasury-related reporting requirements within a global corporate environment. This role will be a hands-on position where a self-driven person will thrive. Your work will be essential in safeguarding financial integrity, supporting the business with reliable treasury insights and enabling future growth.

As a key member of the global finance team, you will manage both local and international treasury needs, collaborate closely with banks, auditors, and internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements across all treasury processes.

The ideal location for this position is Helsinki, Finland, however we would consider suitably qualified individuals based in Vaasa or Turku.

Key Responsibilities

Cash & Liquidity Management


* Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity to support global operations and strategic initiatives.
* Manage global cash pooling structures, daily cash positioning, and short- to long-term cash flow forecasts.
* Optimise cash deployment and internal funding between group entities, enhancing working capital efficiency.
* Provide management with timely insights and recommendations on cash movements, trends and requirements.


Hedging & Financial Risk Management


* Develop, execute, and monitor hedging strategies for foreign exchange in alignment with corporate risk policies.
* Assess financial risks and propose mitigation strategies based on market developments and business needs.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and treasury governance frameworks.


Guarantees


* Manage the full portfolio of bank guarantees, letters of credit, parent company guarantees and other trade finance instruments.
* Oversee the issuance, amendment, extension, and cancellation of guarantees in a timely and compliant manner.
* Partner with commercial, legal, and project teams to structure trade finance solutions that support contract execution.


Bank Relationship Management


* Establish and maintain strong, strategic relationships with global banks and financial partners.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, facility structures, and service agreements to ensure optimal banking support for the business.
* Monitor banking performance, market conditions, competitive offerings to drive continuous improvement and cost efficiency.


Additional Contributions


* Liaison closely with the businesses' trade finance team on different trade finance topics
* Manage treasury reporting and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, and digitalization within treasury processes.
* Provide guidance and support to finance team on treasury-related matters.
* Manage corporate financing activities, including credit facilities and capital structure development, as needed.


We are opening this role for an extended period due to the extended summer vacation period in Finland, however we reserve the right to move forward with individuals during the advertising period.

jobs.title: (Senior) Machine Learning Engineer, Robot Learning (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Batch Robotics is revolutionizing how robots operate in factories — not through rigid programming or teaching by human demonstration, but with smart perception and AI intelligence. We are a team of 4 motivated people with +25 years of experience in industry and robotics. Our mission is to make robots smarter and more flexible, enabling batch-size-1 automation for surface treatment economically. Our technology helps factories in Europe to remain competitive with intelligent robotics.

We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with technical excellence and entrepreneurial drive to join us in developing the next generation of AI-driven robotic systems!

Tasks

  • End-to-End ML Systems: Design, implement, and train state-of-the-art AI models for perception and control of robot arms.
  • Data Pipelines & ML Ops: Collect real-world data from factory deployments to optimize model training and update models in the field.
  • Simulation & Synthetic Data: Work and improve simulation-based tooling (e.g., NVIDIA Newton Physics Engine) for physical AI and scalable synthetic data generation.
  • Model Development: Build ML components across perception and policy pathways, including video models, multimodal encoders, world models, and diffusion/transformer architectures.
  • Systems Integration: Work with real-world, multimodal datasets (vision, force/torque, tactile) and ensure models operate reliably under real-time constraints on physical hardware.
  • Evaluation & Iteration: Test models in realistic environments, analyze failures, and refine for stability, latency, and robustness.

Requirements

  • Background: Master's Degree and more than 3 years of professional experience or a (almost) finished PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Deep experience: Hands-on work with reinforcement learning (RL) and imitation learning within physics simulations.
  • Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and ideally Rust; ability to write clean, modular, and performance-optimized code for distributed workloads using AI agents.
  • Real-World Mindset: Proven track record of deploying models on physical robotic manipulators and handling noisy, temporal, or large-scale datasets.Soft Skills: Entrepreneurial drive, solution-oriented mindset, high agency and the ability to take direct responsibility in a fast-paced startup environment.

Benefits

  • Ownership: opportunity to actively shape the company's technical direction; potential shares in the company.

jobs.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics Engineer
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Imagine working in a team where your expertise in fluid dynamics and thermal analysis drives innovation in product design and performance. Collaborate with specialists who use advanced computer modeling techniques to solve complex challenges in combustion CFD, aerothermal CFD and heat transfer. Dive into assessing the thermal tolerance of products, ensuring they function reliably under changing thermal conditions. Work with both solid and fluid systems, applying your analytical skills to optimize component performance and support cutting-edge engineering solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Apply specialized skills in fluid dynamics using computer modeling to analyze and optimize product performance.
    Conduct thermal analysis and assess heat transfer for products exposed to varying thermal conditions.
    Evaluate the thermal tolerance of components, ensuring reliable operation in both solid and fluid systems.
    Collaborate with a team of experts to deliver innovative solutions through advanced simulation techniques.

What You Bring

    Master or PhD degree in CFD, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, energy or similar
    Strong background in fluid dynamics, with experience in turbulence modeling and thermal analysis for both fluid and solid systems.
    Enjoys problem solving with good analytical skills to solve complex engineering challenges
    Willingness to learn
    Ability to work collaboratively within a specialized technical team.

Previous experience with gas turbines or combustion systems is an advantage.

About the Team

Join a dedicated group of engineers in the CFD, Heat transfer and Mechanical integrity team, where specialized skills in fluid dynamics and heat transfer drive product innovation. The team leverages advanced computer modeling techniques to tackle challenges in both solid and fluid systems, ensuring products meet demanding thermal and performance requirements. Our department is highly focused on increasing fuel flexibility, including the use of gaseous and liquid fuels such as hydrogen, ammonia and biofuels. As part of our team of skilled engineers, you will play a crucial role in designing and operating combustion systems that are reliable, robust, and highly efficient.
Together, you’ll collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of engineering and deliver reliable solutions for a wide range of applications.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.title: Vi søker Butikkmedarbeider, deltid til REMA 1000 Stathelle!
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert og aktiv deltidsjobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Hos oss handler det om mer enn å fylle hyllene. Vi leter etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen til kundene våre – noen som møter dem med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Som butikkmedarbeider får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har fylt 18 år
  • Fleksibel, da vi har Grenlands råeste åpningstider, 6-24 ;o)

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.title: Quant Risk and Valuation Sales Manager for the Nordics

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust.

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a high-performing Sales Manager to drive the growth of our Data Intelligence business across the Nordics. This role will focus on a combination of new business acquisition and expansion within existing accounts, targeting financial institutions looking to enhance their valuation, risk management, regulatory reporting and market intelligence capabilities.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in positioning Infront Quant’s Risk and Valuation solutions that help financial institutions improve decision-making, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency and risk management. This is a unique opportunity to drive meaningful market expansion by bringing a flexible and integrated suite of Data Intelligence solutions to a broad range of financial institutions. Combining strategic new business development with account growth initiatives, you will have a direct impact on increasing market adoption, expanding client relationships and helping shape the continued success of our Data Intelligence business.

As our Quant Risk and Valuation Sales Manager, your key responsibilities will be:

    Drive new client acquisition across the Nordic financial services market.
    Identify opportunities to introduce Valuation & Risk, Regulatory Solutions and Data and Market Intelligence offerings into target accounts.
    Develop opportunities to expand adoption of risk and valuation solutions within existing accounts.
