jobs.title: Quality manager in Projects
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic modernization and upgrades (M&U) project management team at Siemens Energy, where you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our gas turbine projects meet all regulatory and customer quality requirements. Imagine leading efforts to perform product risk analyses, reviewing customer contracts, and creating essential project quality documentation. You will engage with customers on quality topics and coordinate with a talented team to ensure that project-specific quality requirements are met. Your proactive approach will help us deliver innovative solutions that support our mission of energizing society sustainably.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You will lead the execution of quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements for M&U projects, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
    Collaborate with project managers to perform product risk analyses, including Substantial Modification analysis and Risk analysis according to the Machinery Directive.
    Review and interpret customer contracts to communicate quality delivery expectations effectively within the project.
    Create, update, and release critical project quality documentation, including the Project Quality Plan and Quality Control Plan.
    Coordinate with third-party inspections and manage country-specific shipment inspections for certifications, ensuring adherence to CE certification processes.

What You Bring

    You have a degree or equivalent experience in a related field, along with 2-3 years of post-graduate work experience.
    Your experience includes working with the Machinery Directive and the CE Certification process.
    You possess strong communication skills and a structured, collaborative approach to problem-solving.
    You are a proactive team player who can lead or follow as needed, with a resourceful mindset to overcome challenges.
    International business experience is preferred, enhancing your ability to navigate diverse environments.

About the Team
Our M&U project management team is a close-knit group of 12 professionals, including 10 project managers and 2 quality managers. Together, we are dedicated to executing modernization and upgrades projects for our global fleet of gas turbines. Our mission is to ensure that every project meets the highest quality standards while supporting the overall goals of Siemens Energy. We thrive on collaboration and are committed to delivering exceptional results that contribute to a sustainable energy future.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.title: Miljøterapeuter med 3-årig helse- og sosialfaglig høyskoleutdanning og miljøarbeider- Oslo/Indre Østfold/Lier
jobs.description:
Vil du gjøre en forskjell for barn og unge? En Lys Fremtid søker miljøterapeuter, miljøarbeidere og nattevakter til avdelinger i Oslo, Indre Østfold og Lier

Oppstart: fra August 2026, etter avtale.

Hos En Lys Fremtid møter vi barn og ungdom med trygghet, omsorg og faglighet. Vi søker engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å være en viktig voksenperson i ungdommens hverdag, og som vil bidra til å skape stabile, trygge og gode relasjoner.

Vi har ledige stillinger som:

  • Miljøterapeut

  • Miljøarbeider

  • Nattevakt (våken/hvilende etter avdelingens behov)

Stillingene er tilgjengelige ved avdelinger i Oslo, Indre Østfold og Lier.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker deg som er trygg, omsorgsfull og relasjonssterk. Du har evne til å møte barn og ungdom med respekt, tålmodighet og forståelse -- også når situasjoner blir krevende.

Du er en person som:

  • Skaper tillit og gode relasjoner.

  • Er rolig og trygg i utfordrende situasjoner.

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner.

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert.

  • Evner å sette tydelige og omsorgsfulle grenser.

  • Ønsker å bidra til utvikling og mestring hos barn og unge.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • Målrettet miljøterapeutisk arbeid.

  • Skape trygge rammer og bidra til en stabil hverdag.

  • Motiverende, relasjonsbyggende og praktisk arbeid med barn og ungdom.

  • Samarbeid med foreldre, foresatte, nettverk og samarbeidspartnere.

  • Dokumentasjon, kartlegging og rapportskriving.

  • Delta i møter, veiledning og faglige refleksjoner.

  • Praktiske oppgaver i avdelingen.

  • Følge gjeldende lovverk, vedtak og interne rutiner.

Kvalifikasjoner For miljøterapeutstillinger:

  • Bachelor innen barnevern, vernepleie, sosialt arbeid eller annen relevant helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning.

  • Erfaring fra miljøterapeutisk arbeid med barn og unge er en fordel.

For miljøarbeider- og nattevaktstillinger:

  • Relevant erfaring fra arbeid med barn og ungdom eller helse- og omsorgssektoren.

  • Relevant fagutdanning er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

For alle stillinger gjelder:

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk.

  • Plettfri vandel er en forutsetning for ansettelse, og gyldig politiattest uten anmerkninger må fremlegges.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du mer enn bare en jobb.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull arbeidshverdag hvor du utgjør en forskjell.

  • God opplæring og faglig oppfølging.

  • Veiledning og kompetanseutvikling.

  • Et inkluderende og faglig sterkt arbeidsmiljø.

  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariff og konkurransedyktige betingelser.

  • Fleksible turnusordninger.

  • Dag-, kveld-, døgn- og nattevakter.

  • Tett oppfølging fra administrasjonen før, under og etter oppdrag.

Hos En Lys Fremtid er vi opptatt av å ta vare på våre ansatte. Vi tror at trygge medarbeidere skaper trygge barn og ungdommer. Derfor er vi tilgjengelige, følger deg tett opp og legger til rette for både faglig og personlig utvikling.

Om En Lys Fremtid

En Lys Fremtid er en profesjonell aktør innen helse- og omsorgssektoren med lang erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge. Våre ansatte har solid fagkompetanse og bred erfaring fra institusjon, miljøterapi og omsorgsarbeid.

Vi tror på relasjonenes betydning og møter alle mennesker med respekt, varme og profesjonalitet. Hos oss er kvalitet, trygghet og faglighet grunnlaget for alt vi gjør.

Flere av våre ledere og rekrutterere har selv erfaring fra institusjonsarbeid og kjenner godt til både utfordringene og mulighetene som følger med yrket. Dette gjør at vi kan gi våre ansatte tett oppfølging, god veiledning og et faglig sterkt arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidssted

  • Oslo

  • Indre Østfold

  • Lier

Oppstart: August 2026

Slik søker du

Vi ber om at du i søknaden opplyser hvilken avdeling du søker på (Oslo, Indre Østfold eller Lier).

Dersom du har en gyldig politiattest uten anmerkninger, ønsker vi at denne legges ved søknaden. Har du ikke en gyldig politiattest tilgjengelig ved søknadstidspunktet, må slik attest fremlegges før en eventuell ansettelse.

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos En Lys Fremtid står mennesker i sentrum. Vi tror at trygge relasjoner skaper utvikling, mestring og gode liv, og møter barn, ungdom, familier og samarbeidspartnere med respekt, omsorg og profesjonalitet.

Vi er en faglig sterk aktør innen helse- og omsorgssektoren med bred erfaring fra barnevern og miljøterapi. Gjennom kvalitet, kompetanse og tett oppfølging skaper vi trygge rammer for både brukere og ansatte.

Våre ledere og rekrutterere har selv erfaring fra institusjonsarbeid og kjenner godt til arbeidshverdagen. Derfor legger vi stor vekt på god opplæring, veiledning og tilgjengelighet, slik at våre ansatte alltid føler seg trygge og ivaretatt.

Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. - Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
- Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
- Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
- Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

jobs.title: VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth
jobs.description:
About HealthCorps

HealthCorps is a national non-profit committed to improving lives by addressing health challenges in communities through innovative programming in education, leadership, and service learning. We empower teens to become change agents within their families, schools, and neighborhoods. Our program is grounded in the understanding that limited access to health education can lead to a lifetime of social, emotional, and physical challenges.

The Opportunity

HealthCorps is launching a new Growth & Strategic Partnerships Division, and the VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth will be its architect, engine, and external face. You'll hold a broad, high-impact portfolio: leading HealthCorps' national funder and strategic partnerships, driving development, grant management, and fundraising, shaping our brand and marketing, and growing our alumni, community, and hub partnership work. You won't do it alone. A national team, along with program managers across our hubs, will help you build and execute this vision.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will hold your own portfolio of partnerships, work closely with leadership to develop and execute strategies that meet HealthCorps' revenue and growth goals, and represent HealthCorps externally at donor meetings, funder convenings, and sector events. This is an ideal role for a mission-aligned leader who can prospect a health system executive and coach a marketing manager in the same week, someone energized by both the hunt and the build.

For-profit and private sector backgrounds are strongly welcomed. If you have driven revenue, built partnerships, and told a compelling brand story, in any sector, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

External Relationship Strategy, Cultivation & Maintenance (30%)

  • Serve as a key external relationship officer alongside the CEO, cultivating and stewarding relationships across health systems, corporate sponsors, school districts, foundations, and community organizations
  • Design and lead a comprehensive partnership strategy spanning grant, sponsor, and programmatic relationships that aligns funder priorities with organizational growth goals
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of new and emerging partnership opportunities, cultivating prospects from first touch through qualification
  • Steward existing partners to deepen loyalty, increase lifetime value, and drive renewals and upgrades
  • Track funding trends and shifting funder priorities to position HealthCorps ahead of major market shifts

Pitching, Proposals & Partner Stewardship (25%)

  • Own the full partnership sales cycle for mid-tier and emerging opportunities, from first outreach through close and activation
  • Develop pitches, proposals, and grant applications that translate HealthCorps' outcomes data into a compelling, fundable case for support
  • Partner with the CEO and leadership to identify, solicit, and close transformational sponsorships for the major annual fundraiser and national and hub-level programming
  • Demonstrate ongoing value to existing partners through exceptional stewardship that keeps them connected to our mission and measurable impact

Brand Strategy & Voice (20%)

  • Set strategic tone and direction for the HealthCorps brand across all external-facing channels and oversee the Marketing Manager in executing it across social media, website, newsletters, and press
  • Lead the design and execution of a brand and communications strategy that builds awareness and trust across funders, partners, and the broader public
  • Partner with program teams to translate research-validated impact data and stories into compelling, consistent external narratives
  • Develop partner-facing collateral â partnership decks, impact reports, and stakeholder communications â that reflect the quality of the organization
  • Represent HealthCorps at conferences, sector events, and media opportunities alongside the CEO and program leaders

Hub, Community & Alumni Partnerships (15%)

  • Build local advisory committees that connect HealthCorps to local civic, education, and philanthropic leaders, in partnership with the Alumni & Community Manager and Program Directors
  • Strengthen HealthCorps' presence in each market by partnering with local teams to plan events, cultivate partnerships, and raise the organization's visibility
  • Cultivate and engage HealthCorps' alumni as a strategic community, building a strong, active network and connecting alumni to advisory roles, volunteer opportunities, and local partnerships that extend our reach

Division Leadership & Team Management (10%)

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Senior Manager of Development, Marketing Manager, Director of Events (part-time), and Alumni & Community Manager
  • Serve as a player-coach who models the work while developing others, holding your own partnership portfolio while coaching the team toward revenue and relationship goals
  • Establish and monitor division KPIs across pipeline, revenue, and brand performance, reporting to the CEO and Board to ensure measurable ROI
  • Manage the division budget and contribute to organization-wide strategic planning as a member of the leadership team

Who You Are

You are a relationship-builder, a closer, and a brand thinker. The ideal candidate brings:

  • 7+years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, sales, or revenue-generating roles, with a demonstrated track record of closing and stewarding high-value relationships. Nonprofit, for-profit, and private sector backgrounds are all strongly welcomed
  • Experience holding your own portfolio while leading and developing a team; you are a player-coach who can model the work and develop others simultaneously
  • Proven pitching and presentation skills; you are comfortable in a boardroom, at a funder meeting, and in a pitch meeting, and you know how to read a room and close
  • Experience setting brand direction and overseeing marketing or communications functions, with the ability to translate complex program outcomes into compelling external narratives
  • Strong written communication skills: from partner proposals to grant narratives to impact reports, your writing moves people to act
  • Familiarity with health systems, corporate social responsibility, education, or youth-serving sectors; experience working with health systems or school districts is a strong plus
  • Comfort building and operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-growth environment where you may be creating systems and structures from scratch
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking. And a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking
  • A genuine belief in the power of near-peer mentorship and a passion for health equity and youth development

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, communications, marketing, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, or revenue leadership in any sector.
  • Experience managing direct reports and leading cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated success closing and growing partnerships, accounts, or revenue relationships and managing a portfolio of accounts
  • Travel to HealthCorps hubs, partner sites, and sector events will be required

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, health systems, corporate social responsibility, or youth-serving organizations, nonprofit or for-profit
  • Track record of building revenue through client, sponsor, or partner relationships; experience with philanthropic fundraising is a plus but not required
  • Experience building advisory boards, local steering committees, or community engagement structures
  • Experience translating a commercial sales or business development skillset into a mission-driven environment
  • Master's degree or equivalent advanced training

Compensation & Benefits

This is a full time, exempt position, and you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package. Yearly compensation for the role depends on a number of factors, including candidates' qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.

Because we operate across multiple states, compensation is aligned with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including salary thresholds where applicable. Slight preference given to the candidate that live in one of our hub areas: Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Cleveland, OH, Oklahoma City, OK, South Florida (Palm Beach/Miami), Houston, TX and Phoenix, AZ.

At HealthCorps, we believe our team members are our greatest asset. That's why full-time employees enjoy comprehensive benefits packages designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Our offerings include

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to relax, recharge, and take care of what matters most
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance to keep you and your family healthy
  • Life Insurance coverage for added piece of mind
  • A 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future
  • Additional ancillary benefits tailored to fit your lifestyle and needs

Plus, HealthCorps proudly recognizes and observes most federal holidays, giving you even more opportunities to rest and connect outside of work.

HealthCorps provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics, and in compliance with all state and federal law requirements.

HealthCorps, Inc. Complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Project Manager Mods & Ups
jobs.description:
A snapshot of your day

Imagine leading exciting refurbishment projects for our gas turbines, where you play a central role in ensuring both technical and economic success. As a project manager within Mods & Ups, you will follow established processes and be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from planning to execution. The work involves close collaboration with customers and the project team to deliver tailored solutions, ranging from delivering a new turbine on an existing or modified package to smaller control system upgrades. The position requires some travel to customers and local representatives, but projects are primarily managed from the office in Finspång. The composition of the project group fluctuates based on the scale and intricacy of the request.

How you will make an impact

    Lead the execution of order projects and ensure a positive financial outcome.
    Follow and implement processes as outlined by PM@Siemens Energy, from PM40 to PM670.
    Be responsible for both technical and economic aspects of the projects towards customers.
    Collaborate with the project team to solve problems and optimize project progress.
    Maintain a strong customer focus and handle complex negotiations with professionalism.

What you bring

    Extensive experience in project management, preferably with certification in PM@Siemens or equivalent standards.
    Technical education and knowledge or experience with gas turbines or alternatively experience with other industrial equipment.
    Ability to complete and improve common processes.
    Ability to express yourself fluently in Swedish and English, both verbally and in writing.
    A strong service mindset and high social competence.
    Flexibility and the ability to manage rapidly emerging changes in customer-specific projects.

About the team

You will be part of an energetic team of project managers who thrive on the unique challenges that each gas turbine and customer presents. Our team values collaboration and uses diverse experiences to creatively deliver results that exceed market expectations. We take pride in our ability to adapt and innovate. Our customers receive the highest level of support for their operational needs. Are you ready to chip in and make a significant impact for our customers!

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 300122 not later than 2026-08-31.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Location: Finspång

jobs.title: Facility cleaner
jobs.description:
Do you want to do work that matters? Are you customer service oriented and like to see the results of your work immediately? At Siskon Siivous, our cleaners are cleanliness professionals - they make sure our customers' premises are clean and safe.

**We are now looking for a facility cleaner in Tuusula**

**What does your working day look like?**

As a cleaner, you are responsible for the general cleanliness and tidiness of our client sites. This job requires efficiency, attention to detail, and flexibility.

**You will succeed in your job if you have:**

- Experience in the cleaning industry

- Good organizational and interpersonal skills

- A positive service attitude and a responsible approach to work

- Fluency in Finnish or English, other languages a plus


**Why us?**

We give you responsibility, but you won't be alone. Our work community is diverse and fair - we get things done right the first time. You'll get a comprehensive induction and the opportunity to learn more. You'll be supported by your supervisor and meet your colleagues regularly, for example in team meetings. We use high-quality cleaning equipment and environmentally friendly products.

**The job in a nutshell:**

- Location: Tuusula -please check the location before applying for the job

- **Permanent employment**

- Hourly salary: 12.26 € / h

- Working hours per week: 12 hours/week

- **Working hours**are from Monday to Saturday between morning, evening and night

- **Fair employer** – we comply with collective agreement for workers in the property services sector


**Interested?**

If you recognize yourself from the description, don't hesitate - submit your application and join us to do work that really matters. With us, you'll be part of a professional team where cleanliness isn't just about cleaning - it's about safety, well-being and a smooth everyday life. Siskon Siivous Oy is a company founded in 1994, which takes good care of its employees and offers reliable and high-quality cleaning services to its customers.

jobs.title: EHS Manager (Projekti)
jobs.description:
**Oletko kokenut EHS-ammattilainen, jolla on kyky johtaa turvallisuuskulttuuria, kehittää toimintatapoja ja vaikuttaa eri sidosryhmien toimintaan? Tässä voi olla urasi seuraava askel.**

Haemme asiakkaallemme **EHS Manageria** kansainväliseen rakennushankkeeseen.

Tehtävässä vastaat työmaan EHS-toiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja valvonnasta. Teet yhteistyötä erityisesti asiakkaan, urakoitsijoiden ja EHS-tiimin kanssa, ja toimit asiantuntijana sekä tukena projektin eri osapuolille.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa kokemusta EHS-johtamisen tehtävistä. Arvostamme kykyä johtaa turvallisuutta ennakoivasti, rakentaa yhteistyötä eri sidosryhmien kanssa sekä jalkauttaa EHS-käytäntöjä.

**Työsuhde** on määräaikainen. Projektin arvioitu kesto on useita vuosia (yli 3v), mutta työsuhteen lopullinen kesto määräytyy projektin etenemisen mukaan.

**Työtehtävät**

- Toimit johtavana EHS-asiantuntijana tiimissä ja työmaalla

- Vastaat EHS-hallintajärjestelmän ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä asiakkaan ja ISO -standardien mukaisesti

- Koordinoit yhteistyötä ja viestintää sekä ohjaat EHS-tiimin päivittäistä työskentelyä rakennushankkeen eri vaiheissa

- Vastaat EHS-perehdytyksistä, turvallisuusvaatimusten jalkauttamisesta sekä riskienhallintatoimenpiteiden toteutumisesta

- Suunnittelet ja toteutat EHS-auditointeja, työmaatarkastuksia ja turvallisuuskierroksia sekä seuraat korjaavien toimenpiteiden toteutumista

- Varmistat riskinarviointien, työmenetelmäkuvausten sekä muiden turvallisuusasiakirjojen laadun, ajantasaisuuden ja vaatimustenmukaisuuden projektin kaikissa vaiheissa

- Osallistut asiakkaan, urakoitsijoiden ja projektin sisäisiin kokouksiin EHS asiantuntijana

- Vastaat EHS-raportoinnista sekä projektin ja asiakkaiden edellyttämien raporttien oikea-aikaisesta toimittamisesta

- Tuet Programme EHS Leadia sekä muita asiantuntijoita


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Valmiutta työskennellä joustavasti projektin tarpeiden mukaisesti, mukaan lukien tarvittaessa vuorotyöskentely

- Vankkaa kokemus EHS-johtamisesta vaativissa rakennus-, teollisuus- tai infrastruktuurihankkeissa

- Hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia sekä sujuvaa MS Office -ohjelmistojen osaamista

- Kykyä johtaa turvallisuuskulttuuria sekä toimia tehokkaasti asiakkaiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- Erinomaisia viestintä- ja yhteistyötaitoja kansainvälisessä tiimissä

- Kielitaito: Työkieli on suomi, sujuva kirjallinen ja suullinen englanti


**Mitä tarjoamme**

jobs.title: BIM Manager – Bravidan merkittävään datakeskushankkeeseen, Kouvola, Kouvola
jobs.description:
Bravida on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista talotekniikan palveluyrityksistä, joka suunnittelee, toteuttaa ja ylläpitää kiinteistöjen teknisiä ratkaisuja koko niiden elinkaaren ajan. Bravidan vahvuuksia ovat korkea tekninen osaaminen, vastuullinen toimintatapa sekä kyky toteuttaa vaativia projekteja eri toimialoilla.

Bolt.Works hakee nyt BIM Manageria määräaikaiseen vuokratyösuhteeseen Bravidan palvelukseen Kouvolaan rakennettavaan kansainväliseen datakeskushankkeeseen.

Kyseessä on poikkeuksellisen vaativa ja teknisesti edistyksellinen projekti, jossa pääset vastaamaan tietomallinnuksen kokonaisuudesta ja varmistamaan, että suunnittelu, rakentaminen ja käyttöönotto etenevät tehokkaasti yhtenäisen digitaalisen tiedon pohjalta. Roolissa toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä suunnittelijoiden, työmaan, aliurakoitsijoiden sekä projektinjohdon kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu

- eri suunnittelualojen mallien koordinointi ja yhteensovittaminen
- törmäystarkastusten (Clash Detection) koordinointi ja seurantapalaverien vetäminen
- Common Data Environment (CDE) -ympäristön hallinta
- tietomallien laadun, ajantasaisuuden ja projektivaatimusten varmistaminen
- suunnittelun, hankinnan, rakentamisen ja käyttöönoton tukeminen BIM:n avulla
- raportointi projektinjohdolle sekä digitaalisten toimintatapojen jatkuva kehittäminen

Odotamme sinulta
- soveltuvaa koulutusta esimerkiksi rakennus-, talotekniikka-, arkkitehtuuri- tai insinöörialalta
- kokemusta BIM-koordinoinnista tai BIM Managerin tehtävistä vaativissa rakennusprojekteissa
- vahvaa osaamista Revitistä, Navisworksista sekä Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 -ympäristöistä tai vastaavista ohjelmistoista
- ymmärrystä tietomallipohjaisesta rakentamisesta ja suunnitteluprosesseista
- kykyä johtaa yhteistyötä eri suunnittelualojen ja urakoitsijoiden välillä
- sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa. Suomen tai ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle
- mahdollisuuden työskennellä yhdessä Suomen merkittävimmistä datakeskushankkeista
- vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin kansainvälisessä projektiorganisaatiossa
- modernit työkalut sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää projektin digitaalisia toimintamalleja
- osaavan projektitiimin tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kasvattaa osaamistasi vaativissa kansainvälisissä hankkeissa

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa projektitoimistolla Kouvolassa. Työsuhde on määräaikainen vuokratyösuhde projektin ajaksi, ja rekrytointi toteutetaan Bolt.Worksin kautta.

Kemikum, med fler än 200 medarbetare, är en av de största institutionerna vid Stockholms universitet. Forskningen vid Kemikum sträcker sig över kemins alla områden som analytisk kemi, fysikalisk kemi, materialkemi, oorganisk och strukturkemi samt organisk kemi. Forskningsprojekten är många från teori till experiment, från ren grundforskning till mer tillämpade projekt ofta med fokus på hållbar kemi men även avancerade analysmetoder av kemikalier och material. Kemikum har en mycket väl utbyggd forskningsinfrastruktur med en mängd utrustning med kvalificerat stöd från stabsforskare.

Kemikum är också värd för utbildningen i kemi på kandidatnivå samt för tre mastersprogram: analytisk kemi, hållbar kemi, samt organisk kemi. Forskarutbildning bedrivs inom fem områden: analytisk kemi, fysikalisk kemi, materialkemi, oorganisk kemi samt organisk kemi.

Mer information om oss finns på: Kemikum

Projektbeskrivning

Projektet syftar till att stödja syntes av nya metallhydridmaterial genom beräkningsbaserad prediktion av stabila hydridfaser under höga tryck samt att utvärdera deras termodynamiska stabilitet under extrema tryck- och temperaturförhållanden.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker en forskare med erfarenhet av beräkningsfysik eller beräkningskemi för att bidra till slutförandet av ett experimentellt forskningsprojekt om syntes av nya metallhydridmaterial vid höga tryck och temperaturer. Den huvudsakliga arbetsuppgiften är att tillämpa metoder för kristallstrukturprediktion för att identifiera sannolika reaktionsprodukter, vilka därefter används som underlag för fasidentifiering i in situ-insamlade diffraktionsdata. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även att analysera de predikterade hydridmaterialens dynamiska och mekaniska stabilitet samt att beräkna tryck- och temperaturberoendet hos deras elektroniska struktur och fononstruktur.

Behörighetskrav

En forskare anställs i huvudsak för forskning och ska ha avlagt doktorsexamen eller har en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen.

Bedömningsgrunder

Vid tillsättningen kommer särskild vikt att fästas vid vetenskaplig skicklighet. Doktorsexamen ska vara inom fasta tillståndets kemi, fysikalisk kemi, materialvetenskap eller geo-/geovetenskap.

Vid urvalsprocessen kommer följande meriter och egenskaper att särskilt beaktas:

    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kristallstrukturprediktions (CSP) metoder såsom USPEX, AIRSS, CALYPSO.
    Påvisad kompetens i ab initio metoder som avser simulering av struktur och egenskaper vid variabla tryck-temperatur villkor. Detta inkluderar ab inito molekyldynamiksimuleringar.
    Erfarenhet av fononberäkningar och beräkning av elektron–fonon-koppling.
    Förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på engelska.
    Dokumenterad vetenskaplig publiceringsmeritering (i relation till karriärstadium).
    Förmåga till samarbete och nätverkande.
    Kreativitet, initiativförmåga och självständighet.

Om anställningen

Anställningen avser heltid och är tidsbegränsad till längst tre månader. Tillträde 2026-09-15 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city.

Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla.

Kontakt

Ytterligare information lämnas av professor Ulrich Häussermann, ulrich.haussermann@su.se.

Ansökan

Du söker anställningen via Stockholms universitets rekryteringssystem. Bifoga personligt brev och CV samt de bilagor som efterfrågas i ansökningsformuläret. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.

Anvisningar för sökande finns på webbsidan: att söka en anställning.

Stockholms universitet bidrar till det hållbara demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom kunskap, upplysning och sanningssökande.

jobs.title: Occitan text provider / éditeur d'ancien occitan (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'Université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry (UMPV) est une université des Humanités : Lettres, Langues, Arts, Sciences Humaines et Sociales. Plus de 22 000 étudiants sont inscrits de la licence au doctorat et 240 diplômes en lien avec les besoins socio-économiques y sont préparés.

Université citoyenne et durable, dont le site principal est installé sur un campus arboré de plus de 10 hectares labellisé Patrimoine du XXe siècle, elle est dotée d'équipements pédagogiques exceptionnels, tels le Musée des Moulages classé, le Théâtre La Vignette « scène conventionnée pour l'émergence et la diversité », le Learning center ATRIUM conçu comme un lieu de savoir vivant, modernisant la fonction de bibliothèque universitaire et les services aux étudiants.

Contexte du recrutement
Projet SRC 2026-1 MIRANDA : Digital Occitan Paleography

Ce projet s'inscrit dans le cadre d'un partenariat de longue date avec les Archives de Montpellier Métropole et s'intéresse au Registre du clavaire, livre de comptes de la ville, rédigé en 1357-1358.
Son objectif est d'offrir une transcription complète de ce livre manuscrit inédit en formant des étudiants avancés d'une part à la paléographie de l'occitan médiéval et, d'autre part, à une utilisation correcte de l'intelligence artificielle. Grâce à la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR), il sera en effet possible d'entraîner l'IA à lire correctement l'occitan (principe du deep learning). Le programme se déroulera de septembre 2026 à mars 2027. En voici le calendrier : recrutement des stagiaires en septembre, installation et apprentissage des outils en octobre, colloque ouvert au public pour présenter les résultats de cette expérience fin mars. Les données produites, partagées selon les principes de la science ouverte, enrichiront les recherches sur l'histoire de Montpellier ainsi que sur la langue politique et administrative de la ville médiévale : l'occitan. Cette initiative saura également sensibiliser la jeune génération à la préservation du patrimoine linguistique et aux enjeux éthiques de l'intelligence artificielle, tout en rapprochant chercheurs, étudiants et citoyens autour d'un héritage commun.

Missions
La personne recrutée aura pour mission l'édition d'un livre manuscrit occitan du Moyen Âge tardif. Elle sera formée à l'utilisation de la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR) assisté par l'IA. Elle devra entraîner la plateforme à lire correctement les folios numérisés d'un livre manuscrit du XIVe siècle (principe du ML  -machine learning-) afin :

- d'éditer les 270 folios du ms. en question.

- de créer un modèle de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite tardomédiévale pour l'occitan.

CONNAISSANCES ET SAVOIRS
Bonne connaissance de la langue occitane médiévale (niveau Master ou Doctorat).

SAVOIR FAIRE OPÉRATIONNELS
IA friendly, disponibilité à l'apprentissage des plateformes de transcription des textes.

SAVOIR ÊTRE
- Écoute,
- Patience,
- Ténacité,
- Autonomie,
- Disponibilité,
- Capacité d'interaction avec les autres membres de l'équipe.

Formations et/ou expérience professionnelle souhaitables
licence ou master d'occitan avec une préprofessionnalisation en paléographie occitane à la clé, connaissance de la TEI (protocole de balisage Text Encoding Initiative).

Rémunération
Pour les personnels contractuels, par référence à la grille de rémunération de l'université soit entre 1 682 € brut mensuel et 1 996€ brut mensuel en fonction de l'expérience acquise sur des fonctions similaires et dans une catégorie d'emploi équivalente :

jobs.description:

Customer First söker en kommersiell, nyfiken och utvecklingsbar person som tycker om att lära känna människor, förstå verksamheter och lösa verkliga problem.

Du ska vilja skapa nya kundrelationer och affärer, men inte genom att pressa, överdriva eller presentera en lösning innan du förstått kunden.

Hos oss börjar en bra affär med rätt frågor.

Vi söker dig som kunder upplever som förtroendeingivande, ordentlig, noggrann och engagerad. Du tar initiativ, driver arbetet framåt och håller det du lovar.

Du kan vara tidigt i din karriär. Det viktiga är inte hur länge du har arbetat, utan hur snabbt du lär dig, hur väl du förstår dina styrkor och svagheter och hur mycket du vill utvecklas.

Du kommer att:

    identifiera organisationer där vi kan skapa värde
    ta initiativ till nya kunddialoger
    förstå kundens verksamhet, mål och problem
    se samband mellan människor, processer, system, data och ekonomi

    utveckla lösningar tillsammans med kunden och våra specialister
    räkna på verksamhetsnytta och ekonomiska effekter
    driva processen från första kontakt till beslut
    bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer

Det kommersiella resultatet är viktigt. Men affären ska vara en följd av att vi har förstått rätt problem och skapat verkligt värde.

Vem vi söker

Du arbetar kanske i dag med konsultativ B2B-försäljning, affärsutveckling, Customer Success, projektledning, verksamhetsutveckling eller lösningsrådgivning.

Vi tror att du:

    har ett tydligt kommersiellt driv
    tar initiativ och skapar egna möjligheter
    lyssnar innan du rekommenderar
    ställer genomtänkta frågor
    arbetar strukturerat och följer upp
    kan göra komplexa frågor begripliga
    har låg prestige och höga ambitioner
    tar ansvar när något blir fel
    vill utvecklas genom återkoppling och verkligt ansvar

Du behöver kunna driva en kundprocess framåt och hjälpa kunden att fatta beslut, utan att rekommendera något som inte är rätt.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos Customer First får du:

    arbeta med AI, teknik, data och verksamhetsutveckling
    skapa affärer som löser verkliga problem
    möta ledningar och centrala beslutsfattare
    arbeta nära bolagets ledning och specialister

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och svara på uppgifterna nedan.

Ansökningar som endast innehåller ett CV eller ett generellt personligt brev går inte vidare.

Välj en verksamhet du känner till. Beskriv på maximalt 150 ord:

    ett viktigt problem
    den sannolika orsaken
    tre frågor du skulle ställa
    vilket värde en förbättring kan skapa

2. Självinsikt

Beskriv:

    dina två främsta styrkor

    vad du konkret gör för att bli bättre

3. Skapa en ny relation

Välj en organisation där Customer First kan skapa värde. Beskriv:

    vem du skulle kontakta

    vilka tre frågor du skulle ställa

Om du går vidare

Vi går då igenom uppgifterna tillsammans med dig.

Vi vill förstå hur du tänker, skapar förtroende, tar initiativ och ser på din egen utveckling. Vi vill också säkerställa att rollen passar dina styrkor och det du är intresserad av.

Vi söker en kommersiell person som förstår verksamheter, tycker om människor och bygger affärer som skapar verkligt värde.
